description: Next storm system 10/21-10/23 for the West, but will hit warm air with high elevation freezing levels upon arrival.  Freezing levels will drop to lower elevations eventually.  Also, minor remnants of Simon 10/18-10/19.  Then, another storm system 10/26-10/29.
